messages:
Maya: Draft release notes for v2.7.0 ready — planning a staging canary tomorrow during the change window (03:30 UTC). Pinning the RN draft now, requesting ops standby. :eyes:

Maya: ```
Changelog v2.7.0
- improved batching kernel for mixed request sizes
- fix: KV cache edge case for long-context sessions
- perf: quantization path improvements (lower mem, same quality)
- infra: graceful fallback routing for exhausted GPUs
```

Lee: LGTM. Quick question — what are the rollback triggers? Need explicit criteria for the ops playbook.

Maya: good call. Rollback criteria: >5% 5xxs over a 10m window OR sustained p99 latency >500ms for 15m OR any node OOM/crash. If triggered, fallback to pinned version `v2.6.9`. Manual rollback allowed sooner on SEV from product.

Sam: noted. deploy-bot needs the release tag pushed and the `pin` metadata in the RN to run the scheduled canary. Also verify the canary traffic split: 2% for first 10m -> 10% next 20m -> 100% if green.

Maya: I added traffic ramp to the RN and set canary lanes to: staging -> canary pool -> prod mirror. Pin line added: `pin: v2.7.0`

deploy-bot: INFO: Canary scheduled for `v2.7.0` at 2026-03-22T03:30:00Z (staging). Pool: `dedicated-staging-01`. Health checks: /health (200) and token-level sanity tests. Auto-rollback: enabled (3 failed health checks). Logs will stream to #eng-releases and the deploy dashboard.

Julia: Can we add a one-line internal blurb for CS and Docs? Suggest: "Performance improvements to inference batching and quantization; no user-facing API changes." I can polish and push to the RN.

Maya: please do — add it under "Internal: Short blurb for CS/Docs".

Lee: also add the precise change window in the RN header and list the oncall rotation for that window. Who's oncall? @Sam?

Sam: I'll be primary oncall for the window (03:00–05:00 UTC). @Maya will be standby. I'll watch metrics and tail deploy logs.

Maya: thanks. I've pinned the RN draft in the doc and updated the rollout matrix. Final link: https://redwood.internal/rn/drafts/v2.7.0 (internal).

Lee: :thumbsup:

Sam: I'll trigger the deploybot dry-run tonight in staging so we can validate orchestration hooks. Will post results here.

Maya: sweet — after dry-run and your thumbs, I'll post the internal announce 1 hour before cutover to channel and to the release mailing list.

Julia: will prep CS blurb and add to RN. Also leaving a short note for support: "If customers report latency regressions, escalate to eng-releases and attach request id."

Maya: all set. thanks everyone — pin remains in place, canary scheduled, rollback lanes defined. I'll update if timing shifts. :white_check_mark:
